arguments.text: Arsenal are strong favourites to win this fixture, with the model making them 51% to claim all three points compared to a league baseline of 28% for away wins. Southampton's chances are significantly diminished at just 24%, well below the 45% home baseline, while the teams are closely matched on a draw at 25% versus 27% baseline. The model expects an Arsenal-dominated affair, with their expected goals of 1.92 nearly double Southampton's 0.96, and the most likely scorelines all feature away victories.
